layout_and_spacing.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 bg-black border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.card: bg-zinc-950 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-white/20
layout_and_spacing.glass_header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10 px-8 py-4

components.button_primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(124,58,237,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(124,58,237,0.5)] data-testid='primary-btn'
components.button_secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-50 border border-white/10 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all data-testid='secondary-btn'
components.input: w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-zinc-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500/50 focus:border-violet-500 transition-all
components.badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-400 border border-violet-500/20

pages: Login (Static, central card, electric violet CTA)
Dashboard (Control room grid: 4 stat cards top, 2 wide charts middle, 2 lists bottom for active projects/recent clients)
Clients (Data table without cards, sharp and dense)
Projects (Kanban board or structured list view)
AI Chat (Conversational UI, glowing violet user/bot bubbles)
AI Agents (Grid of agent cards with abstract glowing avatars)
Analytics (Dense charts using Recharts, dark tooltips)

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Implement a fixed sidebar layout with React Router navigating the 11 pages. Use Recharts for all dashboard analytics with dark backgrounds. Maintain exactly 1px borders with border-white/10 for all cards and inputs. Avoid using generic Inter font; use Outfit everywhere.
